outcome: cervicovaginal and rectal colonization by Group B Streptococcus (GBS)
cohort: The study included 3,347 pregnant women in labor from Mexico with at least 36 weeks of gestation.
finding: The overall percentage of Group B Streptococcus colonization in this population of pregnant women was low at 4.3%, with Serotype I being the most common at 58%.
cross-section timing: During labor, when women were at or beyond 36 weeks of gestation.
